enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running against the warm night air
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed on back. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Bend knee. Fan blows air. Continue sleeping. Turn onto stomach. Move leg. Breathe deeply. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, quick cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up in bed. Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down toothbrush. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Turn off light. Turn off water heater. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle, toast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Take out jam. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Take out plate. Open toaster. Insert bread slices. Press toaster lever down. Open kettle lid. Fill kettle with water. Close lid. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Wait. Toast pops up. Take out toast. Place on plate. Spread butter on toast. Spread jam on toast. Pour boiled water into cup. Add tea bag. Stir. Sit at table. Pick up toast. Eat. Drink tea. Finish eating. Stand up. Clear table. Turn off kettle. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing work bag, checking the day's program schedule on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Put in laptop. Put in notebook. Put in pen. Zip bag. Turn on computer. Open program schedule. Read schedule. Type notes. Turn off computer. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit: coordinating community programs, running partner meetings and updating schedules
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Greet colleague. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Check emails. Open calendar. Attend partner meeting. Take notes. Discuss program coordination. Return to desk. Update schedules on computer. Make phone calls. Send emails. Follow up with partners. Check schedule. Attend another meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Update program documents. Send emails.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Leave office. Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Find table. Sit. Eat. Drink. Finish. Dispose trash. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit: drafting program reports, following up with volunteers and community partners
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open report template. Type report. Review data. Edit text. Save report. Open email. Send report to supervisor. Call volunteer. Discuss tasks. Send follow-up email. Update volunteer list. Check schedule. Make more calls. Send emails. Update partner contact list. Draft follow-up plan. Send final emails.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating, range hood on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on range hood. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Cover pan. Wait. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat. Drink. Finish. Stand up. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the counters
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape plates into trash. Stack dishes. Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Pick up sponge. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place in drying rack. Wash glass. Rinse. Place in rack. Wash utensils. Rinse. Place in rack. Drain sink. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse cloth. Wipe stove. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting in the bedroom with the fan on, avoiding air-conditioner use during the grid peak
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open door. Enter. Close door. Turn on fan. Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to other side. Stretch. Breathe.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing in the cooled living room now that the peak window has passed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on air conditioner. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Change channel. Watch TV. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Return to living room. Sit. Drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Apply toothpaste. Brush. Rinse. Spit. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind-down: reading and checking phone under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp. Turn on fan. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to other side. Stretch. Fan runs. Sleep. Turn again. Move arm. Move leg. Breathe deeply. Sleep.
